description: A script that checks copyright header formats in source files, ensuring correct years and author attribution, and identifies new files based on git diffs.

methods.name: MetadataInParentDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a 'METADATA' file exists in any parent directory of the given filename.

methods.name: GetCreatedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of new files added between two git references, based on environment variables.

methods.name: CheckCopyrightYear
methods.description: Verifies that source files have the correct copyright year and author header.
